task.title: Allocating the monies — Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction

step.cmd: Refer to Extension of the benefit period and go to step 45.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li:
Remarks line 1: Enter the appropriate option:
For WCB and preventive withdrawal payments, type “M175 B — $ [amount to be allocated] from XXXX-X (first day of allocation) to XXXX-X (last day of allocation), $ [amount to be allocated on the last week if different].”
For SUB, motor vehicle accident insurance, or long-term disability payments, type “M175 E — $ [amount to be allocated] from XXXX-X (first day of allocation) to XXXX-X (last day of allocation), $ [amount to be allocated on the last week if different].”
For PSL, type “M175 L — $ [amount to be allocated] from XXXX-X (first day of allocation) to XXXX-X (last day of allocation), $ [amount to be allocated on the last week if different].”
For WLI, type “M175 F — $ [amount to be allocated] from XXXX-X (first day of allocation) to XXXX-X (last day of allocation), $ [amount to be allocated on the last week if different].”
Remarks line 2: Use if more than one week or more than one type of earnings must be allocated.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, send the D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Allocation of earnings (2516)
Weekly Indemnity allocation (2529): Select the appropriate option based on the client’s situation.

step.cmd: Determine if the incapacity monies were declared on the claimant’s report:
In FTS, determine if there are any rejected claimant’s reports on the Pending/Reject tab:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Actioning a rejected claimant’s report to re-input the reports. Actioning a rejected claimant’s report

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
